releaseNotes:
• Audible Radio Audio Stream: Restored full audio audibility by proxying all m3u8 playlists and TS audio chunks with full CORS headers, preventing browser silent-stream blocks
• Real Software Volume Control: Integrated Web Audio API GainNode for smooth, real-time volume slider adjustment on Android WebView, iOS, and Web
• Verified Working Stations: Filtered Akashvani and Private FM catalogs to 100% active, verified live stations (Vividh Bharati, Akashvani Bhopal, FM Gold, etc.)
• Permanent DOM Audio Mounting: Mounted audio element directly in the DOM tree, preventing Android WebView from suspending or muting background playback
